# Support

Tintly is a free project kept by one volunteer. This page tells you where to go for each kind of help.

## Read the user guide first

The [user guide](https://enaloo.com/apps/tintly/) covers the toolbar window, the modes, the engines, site rules, schedules, fixes, backup and privacy.

## Ask a question

Use [Discussions](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/Tintly/discussions). Say what you want to do and what you tried. Search first. Someone may have asked already.

## Report a page that looks wrong

Use the [page looks wrong form](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/Tintly/issues/new?template=site_breakage.yml). Give the address, the mode and engine, your versions, a screenshot and what the page should look like. Trying another engine in the toolbar window is a good first step, and it helps to say what you saw.

## Report a bug

Use the [bug report form](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/Tintly/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml). [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md#report-a-bug-well) explains what makes a good report.

## Request a feature

Use the [feature request form](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/Tintly/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml). Describe the problem first. This project makes no network requests and asks for few permissions, so some ideas will not fit.

## Fix or add a translation

Use the [translation form](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/Tintly/issues/new?template=translation_fix.yml), or send a pull request. See [Interface text and languages](CONTRIBUTING.md#interface-text-and-languages).

## Report a security problem

Do not open a public issue. Use the [private vulnerability report](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/Tintly/security/advisories/new) and read [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## Privacy questions

Read the [privacy policy](../docs/PRIVACY.md). If it does not answer your question, ask in Discussions. Do not include personal data.

## Please never post

Passwords, tokens, private pages, or screenshots that show private data. Issues are public.

## What to expect

- Help comes from a volunteer in spare time. Replies are best effort, with no guaranteed time.
- There is no phone, email or chat support.
- Only the latest code is supported. Please update before you report a bug.
- Please be kind. The [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) applies in every issue, discussion and pull request.

If you want to support the project, you can [buy the maintainer a coffee](https://buymeacoffee.com/enaloo). It is not expected and changes nothing about how issues are handled.
